t: A credit-card-sized Linux computer for desktops, servers, robots, and home AI projects.
steps: Buy a Raspberry Pi 5 from a maker shop, along with the official 5 A USB-C power supply.
Get a microSD card, a micro-HDMI cable, a keyboard, a mouse, and an active cooler.
Install the free Raspberry Pi Imager app on another computer.
Write Raspberry Pi OS to the microSD card with Imager.
Insert the card, connect the screen, and plug in power.
Follow the setup screens to join Wi-Fi and create your account.
Open Thonny and blink an LED with a gpiozero example.
meta: Open Code. From $45. Easy to find.
